choices.summary: See invisible creatures and objects within 10 feet in line of sight.

features.name: Enchantment Savant
features.summary: Copying enchantment spells into your spellbook costs half the usual gold and time.

features.name: Hypnotic Gaze
features.summary: Action: a creature within 5 feet that can see or hear you makes a Wisdom save or is charmed, speed 0 and incapacitated until your next turn ends; sustain with an action each turn. On a save or end, can't target it again until a long rest.

features.name: Instinctive Charm
features.summary: Reaction: an attacker within 30 feet makes a Wisdom save or must redirect its attack to the nearest other creature in range; on a success you can't use this on it until a long rest.

features.name: Split Enchantment
features.summary: A 1st+ level enchantment spell that targets only one creature can target a second creature.

features.name: Alter Memories
features.summary: When you charm creatures with an enchantment spell, one stays unaware it was charmed; before the spell ends, an action can make it lose up to 1 + Cha mod hours of memory on a failed Int save.

features.name: Illusion Savant
features.summary: Copying illusion spells into your spellbook costs half the usual gold and time.

features.name: Improved Minor Illusion
features.summary: Learn minor illusion (or another wizard cantrip if known) without it counting against cantrips known; your minor illusion can make both a sound and an image.

features.name: Malleable Illusions
features.summary: Action: reshape an active illusion spell of yours with duration 1 minute or longer, within that spell's parameters, while you can see it.

features.name: Illusory Self
features.summary: Reaction to an attack roll against you: an illusory double makes the attack miss automatically.

features.name: Illusory Reality
features.summary: While a 1st+ level illusion spell lasts, bonus action: make one inanimate, nonmagical object in it real for 1 minute; it can't deal damage or directly harm anyone.

features.name: Necromancy Savant
features.summary: Copying necromancy spells into your spellbook costs half the usual gold and time.

features.name: Grim Harvest
features.summary: Once per turn, killing creatures with a 1st+ level spell heals you 2 x spell level (3 x for necromancy spells); not for constructs or undead.

features.name: Undead Thralls
features.summary: Gain animate dead in your spellbook; it raises one extra corpse. Undead you create with necromancy get extra max HP equal to your wizard level and add your proficiency bonus to weapon damage.

features.name: Inured to Undeath
features.summary: Resistance to necrotic damage, and your hit point maximum can't be reduced.

features.name: Command Undead
features.summary: Action: an undead within 60 feet makes a Charisma save or becomes friendly and obeys you until you use this again; smart undead (Int 8+) get advantage, Int 12+ can re-save each turn. A success makes it permanently immune to this feature.

features.name: Transmutation Savant
features.summary: Copying transmutation spells into your spellbook costs half the usual gold and time.

features.name: Minor Alchemy
features.summary: Spend 10 minutes per cubic foot (up to 1 cubic foot) to turn wood, stone (not gems), iron, copper, or silver into another of those for 1 hour or until your concentration breaks.

features.name: Transmuter's Stone
features.summary: Spend 8 hours to craft a stone granting its bearer one chosen benefit; casting a 1st+ level transmutation spell lets you change the benefit. Making a new stone ends the old one.

features.name: Shapechanger
features.summary: Add polymorph to your spellbook; once per short or long rest cast it without a slot on yourself only, becoming a beast of CR 1 or lower.

features.name: Master Transmuter
features.summary: Action: destroy your transmuter's stone to produce one major effect; the stone can't be remade until a long rest.

choices.summary: +10 feet speed while unencumbered.

choices.name: Constitution saves
choices.summary: Proficiency in Constitution saving throws.

choices.name: Energy resistance
choices.summary: Resistance to acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage (chosen each time this benefit is picked).

choices.summary: Over 10 minutes, turn a nonmagical object up to a 5-foot cube into another nonmagical object of similar size and mass and equal or lower value.

choices.name: Panacea
choices.summary: Touched creature is cured of all curses, diseases, and poisons and regains all hit points.

choices.name: Restore Life
choices.summary: Cast raise dead by touch with no slot and no need to have it in your spellbook.

choices.name: Restore Youth
choices.summary: A willing touched creature's apparent age drops by 3d10 years (minimum 13); lifespan is not extended.
